ModifyInstanceConfig.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的参数配置

ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.description_en: Modifies the maintenance window of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. Alibaba Cloud maintains Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances during the specified maintenance window
ModifyInstanceMaintainTime.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的可维护时段，阿里云将在您设定的可维护时段内对实例进行例行维护

ModifyInstanceMajorVersion.description_en: Upgrades the major version of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ModifyInstanceMajorVersion.description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的大版本

ModifyInstanceMinorVersion.description_en: Updates the minor version of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ModifyInstanceMinorVersion.description_zh: 升级云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的小版本

ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime.description_en: Extends the retention period of the classic network endpoint of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. You can call this operation after you change the network type of the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance from classic network to Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) with the classic network endpoint retained
ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime.description_zh: 若云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例之前执行过由经典网络向VPC网络切换，并保留了经典网络连接地址，则可调用本接口延长经典网络连接地址的保留时间

ModifyInstanceParameter.description_en: Applies a parameter template to specific instances. This indicates that the parameter values in the template take effect on the instances. After you modify a parameter template, you must reapply it to specific instances for the new parameter values to take effect on the instances
ModifyInstanceParameter.description_zh: 将参数模板应用至指定实例，表示将参数模板的值赋于指定的实例中。当您修改参数模版后，您也需要重新应用至指定实例，才能将修改后的参数值赋于指定实例

ModifyInstanceSSL.description_en: Enables Transport Layer Security (TLS) for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ModifyInstanceSSL.description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启TLS（Transport Layer Security）加密协议配置

ModifyInstanceSpec.description_en: Changes the specifications of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
ModifyInstanceSpec.description_zh: 变更云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的规格

ModifyInstanceTDE.description_en: Enables transparent data encryption (TDE) for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. You can use existing custom keys
ModifyInstanceTDE.description_zh: 为云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例开启透明数据加密TDE功能，支持自定义密钥

ModifyInstanceVpcAuthMode.description_en: Enables or disables password-free access for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. This way, you can connect to a database in a convenient and secure manner
ModifyInstanceVpcAuthMode.description_zh: 开启或关闭专有网络免密访问。开启后，同一专有网络内的云服务器无需使用密码即可连接云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例，同时也继续兼容通过用户名和密码的方式连接实例

ModifyIntranetAttribute.description_en: Temporarily adjusts the internal bandwidth of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance that is deployed in a dedicated cluster
ModifyIntranetAttribute.description_zh: 临时调整专属集群中云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的内网带宽

ModifyParameterGroup.description_en: Modifies the settings of a parameter template

ModifyResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance belongs
ModifyResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例所属的资源组

ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration.description_en: Resets the security groups that are added to the whitelists of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration.description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例白名单中的安全组

ModifySecurityIps.description_en: Configures an IP address whitelist for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ModifySecurityIps.description_zh: 设置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的IP白名单

ModifyTaskInfo.description_en: Modifies the task information, such as the task execution time
ModifyTaskInfo.description_zh: 进行任务操作，当前支持修改任务执行时间点

RebootProxy.description_en: Restarts the proxy node of a running Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
RebootProxy.description_zh: 重启运行中的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的代理节点

ReleaseDirectConnection.description_en: Releases the private endpoint of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) cluster instance
ReleaseDirectConnection.description_zh: 释放云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的直连地址

ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_en: Releases the public endpoint of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ReleaseInstancePublicConnection.description_zh: 释放云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的公网连接地址

RemoveSubInstance.description_en: Removes a child instance from a distributed instance
RemoveSubInstance.description_zh: 将子实例从分布式实例中移除并转变为普通实例（数据会被保留）

RenewAdditionalBandwidth.description_en: This operation is not recommended now. The billing method for bandwidth of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance is changed to pay-as-you-go
RenewAdditionalBandwidth.description_zh: 云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的带宽已升级为按量付费模式，不再推荐使用本接口

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) subscription instance
RenewInstance.description_zh: 为包年包月的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例续费

ResetAccountPassword.description_en: Resets the password of an account for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
ResetAccountPassword.description_zh: 重置云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）账号的密码

RestartInstance.description_en: Restarts a running Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
RestartInstance.description_zh: 重启运行中的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例

RestoreInstance.description_en: Restores data from a specified backup file to a Tair (Redis-compatible) instance
RestoreInstance.description_zh: 恢复指定备份文件中的数据到云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中

SwitchInstanceHA.description_en: Performs a primary/secondary switchover (switches node roles). This operation can be used for disaster recovery drills and nearest access for applications in multi-zone deployment scenarios
SwitchInstanceHA.description_zh: 执行主备切换（即切换节点角色），可应用于容灾演练、多可用区场景下的应用就近连接等需求

SwitchInstanceProxy.description_en: Enables or disables the proxy mode for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) cluster instance in a dedicated cluster
SwitchInstanceProxy.description_zh: 开启或关闭专属集群中云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的代理模式

SwitchInstanceToTargetZone.description_en: 实例指定目标可用区切换
SwitchInstanceToTargetZone.description_zh: 实例指定目标可用区切换

SwitchInstanceZoneFailOver.description_en: Switches an instance from the current zone to the specified zone in the event of a fault
SwitchInstanceZoneFailOver.description_zh: 模拟云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群架构实例发生可用区级别故障，实例将自动切换到备可用区中

SwitchNetwork.description_en: Changes the VPC or vSwitch of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. If the instance is deployed in the classic network, the network type of the instance is changed from the classic network to VPC
SwitchNetwork.description_zh: 切换云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的专有网络VPC或交换机，如果实例为经典网络，则会将其切换为专有网络

SyncDtsStatus.description_en: Disables configuration changes for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance before you use Data Transmission Service (DTS) to migrate or synchronize data of the instance. This prevents migration and synchronization task failures due to configuration changes
SyncDtsStatus.description_zh: 在使用DTS迁移或同步云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的数据前，您可以调用本接口限制该实例执行变配操作，避免因变配引起的数据迁移或同步任务失败

TagResources.description_en: Adds tags to Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances
TagResources.description_zh: 为一个或多个云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例绑定标签

TransformInstanceChargeType.description_en: Changes the billing method for a Tair instance between subscription and pay-as-you-go
TransformInstanceChargeType.description_zh: 转换云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的付费类型，支持按量付费和包年包月付费类型之间的相互转换

TransformToEcs.description_en: Converts an instance that uses local disk to a cloud-native instance

TransformToPrePaid.description_en: Converts a pay-as-you-go ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis-compatible) instance to the subscription billing method
TransformToPrePaid.description_zh: 将按量付费的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例转换为包年包月（预付费）实例

UnlockDBInstanceWrite.description_en: Unlocks a write-locked instance. After the instance is unlocked, you can read and write data to and from the instance
UnlockDBInstanceWrite.description_zh: 对写锁定的实例进行解锁，解锁后，实例支持读取、写入数据

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances
UntagResources.description_zh: 将标签从云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例解绑

UpgradeProxy.description_en: Updates the proxy node of a cluster instance to the latest version
UpgradeProxy.description_zh: 升级集群版实例代理节点 proxy 到最新的版本
